```{r}
enrichment_dir <- file.path(PROJECTPATH, "data/mouse/derivatives/v3/107/enrichment/StringDB_12.0_Bader_2025/950")

permutations_dir <- file.path(enrichment_dir, "permutations")
```

```{r}
# Path to Reactome hierarchy file
reactome_hierarchy <- file.path(PROJECTPATH,  "data/enrichment/reactome_hierarchy.csv")

# Import Reactome hierarchy
df_reactome_hierarchy <- read_csv(reactome_hierarchy, show_col_types = FALSE)

# Initialize tree levels for root pathways
df_reactome_hierarchy <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
  mutate(level = ifelse(is.na(ParentID), 0, NA))

# Iterate lvl down the tree
nmissing <- sum(is.na(df_reactome_hierarchy$level))
lvl <- 0
while (nmissing > 0) {
  
  df_reactome_lvl <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
    filter(level == lvl)
  
  # Iterate over nodes at given level
  for (i in 1:nrow(df_reactome_lvl)){
    
    node <- df_reactome_lvl[[i, "Name"]]
    
    df_reactome_hierarchy <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
      mutate(level = ifelse(is.na(Parent), 0, 
                            ifelse(Parent == node, lvl+1, level)))
    
  }
  
  nmissing <- sum(is.na(df_reactome_hierarchy$level))
  lvl <- lvl + 1
  
}

# Clean up names
df_reactome_hierarchy <- df_reactome_hierarchy %>% 
  mutate(Name = str_replace_all(Name, "  ", " "),
         Name = str_replace_all(Name, "/", " "))
```

```{r}
# Bader Reactome gene sets
module_file <- file.path(PROJECTPATH,  "data/enrichment/Human_Reactome_June_01_2025_symbol.gmt")

# Import Bader sets
df_modules <- get_module_sizes(modules = module_file)

# Clean up IDs
df_modules <- df_modules %>% 
  rename(IDBader = ID) %>% 
  mutate(ID = IDBader %>% 
           str_split_i("%", i = -1) %>% 
           str_remove("R-HSA-") %>% 
           str_remove("\\.[0-9]+"),
         ID = paste0("R-HSA-", ID)) %>% 
  mutate(Title = str_replace_all(Title, "  ", " "))

# Include hierarchy information
df_reactome <- inner_join(df_reactome_hierarchy,
                          df_modules,
                          by = "ID")

# Pathways to keep
pathway_ids_keep <- df_reactome %>% 
  filter(B > 10) %>% 
  pull(IDBader)
```

```{r}
enrichment_file <- "cluster_pathway_enrichment.csv"
enrichment_file <- file.path(enrichment_dir, enrichment_file)
df_enrichment <- read_csv(enrichment_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

nk_select <- 6
k_select <- 1

df_enrichment_cluster <- df_enrichment |> 
filter(nk == nk_select, k == k_select)


df_enrichment_cluster <- df_enrichment_cluster |> 
  filter(ID %in% pathway_ids_keep)

df_enrichment_cluster

pathway_title <- "Signaling by WNT"
```

```{r}
permutation_files <- list.files(permutations_dir)
permutation_files <- file.path(permutations_dir, permutation_files)

list_enrichment_permutations <- vector(mode = "list", length = length(permutation_files))
for (i in 1:length(list_enrichment_permutations)) {
  
  df_enrichment_i <- read_csv(permutation_files[i], show_col_types = FALSE)
  
  df_enrichment_i$seed <- permutation_files[i] |> 
    basename() |> 
    str_extract("seed_[0-9]+") |> 
    str_remove("seed_") |> 
    as.numeric()
  
  df_enrichment_i <- df_enrichment_i |> 
    filter(nk == nk_select, k == k_select) |> 
    filter(ID %in% pathway_ids_keep) |> 
    filter(Title == pathway_title)
  
  list_enrichment_permutations[[i]] <- df_enrichment_i
    
}

df_enrichment_permutations_WNT <- bind_rows(list_enrichment_permutations)

df_enrichment_permutations_WNT
```

```{r}
df_enrichment_cluster_WNT <- df_enrichment_cluster |>
  filter(Title == pathway_title)

df_enrichment_cluster_WNT
```

```{r}
ggplot(df_enrichment_permutations_WNT, aes(x = NLQ)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 50) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = df_enrichment_cluster_WNT$NLQ) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = median(df_enrichment_permutations_WNT$NLQ), col = "red") + 
  theme_bw()
```
